prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' — the server incorrectly requires both 'application/json' AND 'text/event-stream' to be present, causing valid JSON-only clients to get a 406 Not Acceptable. prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' — the server incorrectly requires both 'application/json' AND 'text/event-stream' to be present, causing valid JSON-only clients to get a 406 Not Acceptable. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs fix the identical validation bug in the same function of webStandardStreamableHttp.ts. #1996 replaces the check with a proper acceptsMediaType() parser that splits the Accept header on commas/semicolons, lowercases for case-insensitive comparison, and honors q=0 exclusions and type/subtype wildcards (89 additions / 8 deletions). #2046 instead uses a bare acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check (37 additions / 8 deletions), which produces false positives on values like 'application/json-seq' or 'application/jsonp', misses differently-cased headers, and ignores q=0 weighting. Same root-cause fix, but #1996's implementation handles more real-world Accept header variants correctly.
